item.title: Silvana V2 brings private trading to Canton, with orders matched away from public view and settled by delivery-versus-payment
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 11:12 AM ET)
- **Silvana V2 brings private trading to Canton, with orders matched away from public view and settled by delivery-versus-payment** — Silvana Book is a live private orderbook for tokenized assets on Canton: orders are matched privately, assets stay in the user's wallet with no escrow until the final trade settles on Canton, and the platform offers direct swaps, private requests for quote, grid strategies and permissioned trading agents; V2 adds a redesigned Trading Terminal, support for Lattice Wallet and an updated EarnHub for campaigns and settled-trade rewards (CantonNews)
- **Zenith co-sponsors bringing IBC under Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust governance, with IBC already integrated into Zenith Testnet** — Zenith joins individuals from Wells Fargo, Figure Markets, OpenZeppelin, Partior and the Cardano Foundation in backing the move to neutral Linux Foundation governance; Zenith is working with the Cosmos team and says the TestNet integration lays the groundwork for cross-chain communication and asset transfers between Zenith and IBC-connected networks beyond Canton, on a protocol that has facilitated more than $50 billion across more than 200 networks (CantonNews)
- **Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz says the U.S. Treasury could issue bills directly on blockchain rails within two to five years** — Speaking at Token2049 on November 9, Rooz set out that outlook for direct Treasury issuance on-chain; it is a forward view from the network's main developer, not a Treasury commitment or a dated programme (CoinStats)
- **Canton Coin derivatives positioning stays long-leaning as open interest rises while the price falls** — CC open interest stood at $40.52 million, up 3.64% over seven days even as the price fell 6.91% over the same period, with funding at 0.0368% per eight hours meaning longs are paying shorts, 24-hour liquidations of $13.60K all on long positions, and 51.3% of Binance CCUSDT accounts long; CoinStats notes these figures come from aggregated sources and may not match exchange-specific data (CoinStats)

item.title: Canton's governance guide sets out how every network change passes the CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 9:42 AM ET)
- **Canton's governance guide sets out how every network change passes the CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date** — Anyone can author a Canton Improvement Proposal; a proposal needs sponsorship from two Super Validators to reach a vote, approval requires a two-thirds supermajority across the 55 Super Validators in a 10-day window with no single entity holding veto power, and a CIP reaches Final status only after two-thirds of Super Validators implement it on-chain through DevNet, TestNet and then MainNet (CantonNews)
- **Canton scores 80 out of 100 for institutional adoption in a new comparison, ranking fourth of 27 tracked cryptocurrencies** — TokenSonar's November 13 comparison puts Canton ahead of Quant at 62 out of 100, citing its bank-infrastructure profile and 10 tracked institutional signals including Goldman Sachs, BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, DTCC and JPMorgan Chase; the scores update twice daily from regulatory filings, named bank deployments, ETF flows and on-chain real-world-asset data rather than price action, and the comparison rates its own data confidence for Canton as medium (TokenSonar)
- **Splice 0.10.2 release notes upgrade Canton to 3.7.3 and remove the last CometBFT support from the Super Validator app** — The release drops the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and debug tab after the CantonBFT migration, and its Scan app now exposes separate featured-asset reward fields under CIP-104 v1.1, with the notes warning explorers that reading only the older app-activity fields will under-report total app rewards minted (Canton Network Docs)
- **Alea Research counts $157.5 million in Canton transaction fees in the third quarter, ahead of Tron, Solana and Ethereum combined** — The analysis, compiled from Alea Research, says Canton led those networks on fee capture in every quarter of 2026 and that current public-market traffic burns already offset about 69% of new CC issuance, up from 11% a year ago; the figures are a research model of network fee capture, not audited network revenue (KuCoin)

item.title: Canton's network now spans more than 830 firms, with the DTCC Tokenization Service able to connect to more than 150 production applications
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)
- **Canton's network now spans more than 830 firms, with the DTCC Tokenization Service able to connect to more than 150 production applications** — Canton's November 12 account of the rollout put the service's initial pool at more than $30 trillion in high-quality liquid assets; the figures describe the network and service the tokenization platform can reach, not Canton Coin demand or token revenue, and the service itself launched on October 28 with Canton and DTCC's private Besu network as its first integrations (ad-hoc-news)
- **SBI and Cambodia's central bank plan a Canton trial for tokenized government bonds** — SBI Holdings and the National Bank of Cambodia signed a memorandum of understanding on November 13 for a proof of concept tokenizing Cambodian government bonds, with Canton as the planned network and interim results and a demonstration due at the Black Swan Summit in Phnom Penh on November 15–16; the central bank will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment, and the stated goal is access to government bonds in smaller amounts through local financial institutions, with service details and timing still to be decided (CantonNews)
- **SBI and the National Bank of Cambodia also agree a Japan–Cambodia remittance trial using the JPYSC yen stablecoin** — The separate November 13 memorandum covers a proof of concept for remittance settlement between financial institutions using JPYSC, giving the SBI–central bank relationship a payments strand alongside the bond tokenization work; no launch date or service terms were announced for the remittance trial (CantonNews)
- **Developers flag that a silent signatory can block settlement of committed Canton Coin allocations until the deadline** — A November 12 Canton Network Forum discussion set out how a committed allocation on Token Standard V2 still archives or creates contracts the owner signs, so an owner whose node stays silent can stall settlement even though the allocation cannot be withdrawn; a respondent confirmed the underlying observer package-vetting dependency is a known problem expected to be removed in future, and recommended app authors defend with economic incentives that quickly exclude misbehaving users, whose own Canton Coin stays locked (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Progmat and Digital Asset move tokenized Japanese government bonds into Phase Two live validation on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)
- **Progmat and Digital Asset move tokenized Japanese government bonds into Phase Two live validation on Canton** — Phase Two, launched in November under the Digital Asset Co-Creation Alliance working group, will test issuing tokenized Japanese government bonds (tJGB), tokenized deposits and stablecoins in the Canton production environment, validate repurchase operations and gradually connect with major collateral platforms in Japan and abroad; the bonds keep the legal status of ordinary book-entry bonds and target 24/7 programmable settlement, with those settlement features still project goals being tested rather than finished products (KuCoin)
- **Review clarifies Canton's $370.5 billion in represented assets is all Broadridge repo recordkeeping, with no distributed tokens** — RWA.xyz data as of November 12 counts $370.5 billion of represented real-world assets on Canton, 88.6% of all represented value it tracks, all in Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo, while showing $0 distributed to investor wallets, 0 holders and $0 of transfers in the last 30 days; Broadridge itself reports DLR processed an average of $345 billion a day in repo transactions in October, $7.6 trillion for the month (Daniil Kozin)
- **Rome Protocol's Ostia EVM testnet has produced more than 53,600 blocks settling on Canton DevNet** — Ostia, deployed on November 12, brings Ethereum-compatible apps to Canton and lets developers test Canton Coin transfers as an ERC-20 token, with each block paired with a zero-knowledge proof; the release remains unaudited, is run by Rome alone and may be reset (CoinMarketCap)
- **Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for one shared Canton Super Validator arrangement under CIP-0130** — The November 10 vote passed with 11 in favour and two non-votes, giving the pair a single participation framework to earn up to 10 reward weight in total through verified milestones, with rewards subject to escrow and governance review before release; the approval does not by itself mean either firm is already operating a separate Super Validator node (CantonNews)

item.title: Valour lists a Canton Coin ETP on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, giving investors securities-account exposure to CC
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 7:12 AM ET)
- **Valour lists a Canton Coin ETP on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, giving investors securities-account exposure to CC** — Valour, a subsidiary of DeFi Technologies, added eight SEK-denominated exchange-traded products in its November 5 announcement, including one referencing Canton Coin alongside Venice Token, Raydium, Morpho, Maple, Pump.fun, Dogwifhat and Bonk; each product tracks its own single token rather than a basket of the eight, the products trade only during securities-market hours rather than around the clock, and a regulated listing is not an endorsement of the underlying token's value (NewsBTC)
- **Tokenomics Committee approves Meridiant and Rocky Wallet as Featured Apps and recognises Tradecraft for delivery-versus-payment** — Meridiant, built by Catalyst Labs, and Rocky Wallet, built by Dune Labs, were approved for Featured App status on MainNet, meaning their activity can earn elevated app rewards once Super Validators confirm the status on-chain, while Tradecraft's C8 Wallet and RFQ DEX were granted DvP recognition; the approval is not an endorsement by the Canton Foundation, and approved apps must stay within the Foundation's guidelines (CC Space)
- **CC Space cuts its Canton alert cost tenfold and widens what its monitoring covers** — Alert deliveries through CC Space, the Canton explorer and API service, now cost 5 credits, about 1.5 cents per notification, down from 50 credits, and the expanded triggers cover validator and Super Validator health, traffic runway, Featured App compliance, party balances and governance proposals, delivered across web, email, Telegram, Slack, PagerDuty and webhook (CC Space)
- **OnePump opens a waitlist for a Canton memecoin launchpad, with no launch date and no token announced** — OnePump, from Terminal Systems Corp, the company behind the OneSwap DEX on Canton, would let anyone create a token that trades on a bonding curve and graduates into a OneSwap liquidity pool, with creators receiving no pre-allocation and activity on the service running on Canton Coin; the launchpad has not opened, no launch date is published, no token or airdrop has been promised, and the waitlist's queue positions and Diamond streaks carry no monetary value under its terms (99Airdrops)

item.title: ChainSafe's Daml Reason gives AI-written Daml a second check before it compiles
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 6:12 AM ET)
- **ChainSafe's Daml Reason gives AI-written Daml a second check before it compiles** — Daml Reason is an MCP server built on 1,461 curated patterns drawn from daml-finance, Splice and the Daml SDK; coding agents get a verdict on draft Daml code before compiling, and the tool abstains when nothing strong matches rather than guessing, adding a review layer for AI-generated contracts on Canton (CantonNews)
- **New Canton paymaster proposal sets out the first step toward Universal Burn** — The draft, announced for discussion on November 10, would let dedicated synchronizers record their traffic in ten-minute intervals and have a designated paymaster burn the corresponding Canton Coin on the Global Synchronizer afterward, with reward eligibility recorded through the paymaster and Super Validators registering the synchronizer; it remains a draft under governance review, with no final pricing curve or deployment date and a first version that trusts operators to report traffic correctly (CantonNews)
- **Supanova restores wallet services after completing its Canton account upgrade** — Supanova announced on November 7 that its account upgrade was complete and wallet creation and withdrawals had resumed, following a temporary pause on new wallet creation; users who had hit a message that their Canton account could not be opened were told to sign in again to create the wallet (CC Tools)

item.title: Canton Foundation welcomes six new members in November 2026, spanning liquidity, infrastructure and tokenized assets
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 5:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Foundation welcomes six new members in November 2026, spanning liquidity, infrastructure and tokenized assets** — Granite River Trading, Altus (formerly B-Harvest), Doppler Finance, Diviko AG, otcDigital Inc and Grofty Labs have joined the Foundation, bringing expertise in market making and OTC execution, blockchain infrastructure and validator operations, vault infrastructure starting with Canton Coin, self-custody wallets built for Canton, a full-lifecycle marketplace for tokenized securities and real-world assets, and a non-custodial wallet and DEX gateway (Canton Foundation)
- **Tritemius expands its iOS wallet through TestFlight as The Hub reports 1,000 members on Canton** — The Tritemius update adds support for cETH, HANDL and Edel's tokenized stock and index products, plus two ways to use Bitcoin's Lightning Network — a one-click option without running a node and a personal-node option — with Lightning remaining a separate wallet capability that does not settle on Canton and availability limited to TestFlight rather than a general App Store release; The Hub, which combines creator content, live rooms and tradable community tickets on Canton, separately reported reaching 1,000 members (CantonNews)
- **Morgan Stanley tokenizes U.S. equities and Treasurys through DTCC's Tokenization Service, one of the first banks to do so** — Announced on November 4 by head of digital-assets strategy Amy Oldenburg, the completions use a service built with input from more than 150 firms and signed by 20 participants at launch, which locks the underlying position at DTC, mints a tokenized representation on Canton or DTCC's private Besu network and mirrors transfers back to DTC records; Morgan Stanley now targets supporting tokenized equities on its alternative trading system in Q1 2027, slipped from an earlier H2 2026 target (Blockchain Posts)
- **Ibex receives a 500,000 CC Genesis Fund grant from Palladium Labs to build new Canton trading products** — Ibex, which is developing private perpetual-futures trading on Canton designed to keep position size, leverage and liquidation levels hidden from other traders, plans to build new offerings using Alpend's credit market, with Alpend confirming it will support Ibex through that market; the announcement sets no launch date for the new products and gives no borrowing terms or eligible collateral (CantonNews)

item.title: SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin returns to focus as markets weigh its limits
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)
- **SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin returns to focus as markets weigh its limits** — Fresh November 13 coverage notes that staff in the SEC's Division of Corporation Finance viewed Canton Coin as a digital commodity under the facts presented by Digital Asset and would not recommend enforcement action over programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers if the stated conditions are followed; the coverage stresses the limits — the response is a staff position rather than a Commission action, expresses no legal conclusion, and does not address secondary-market trading of CC (ad-hoc-news)
- **Canton Strategic CEO warns MEV could raise hidden costs for tokenized stock traders** — Mark Wendland said issuers and investors need protection against traders who gain priority over other transactions, arguing that payments to validators can leave other users with less favourable prices; he said Canton is designed to prohibit MEV in structure and practice, with no universal visibility of pending orders and validators unable to accept payments to change their place in the sequence, while a Helius report tracked 1.55 million sandwich transactions and $13.43 million in profit from one Solana program (WEEX)
- **ETP Foundry builds a tokenized-fund toolkit on Canton and seeks its first fund sponsors** — The toolkit lets a fund company launch and run a tokenized fund on Canton without building the plumbing itself: fund shares are a standard Canton token under CIP-56, market makers create and redeem shares in one atomic transaction with the basket or with cash, and the daily net asset value is calculated automatically and signed on the ledger by the fund's own parties; its Foundation-approved validator has run on DevNet since September 24 with test funds holding cBTC, cETH and Canton Coin, and it plans Canton Development Fund applications under RFP 11 and RFP 12 as open tooling, still seeking a Tech & Ops Champion, with its code not yet independently audited and everything still on DevNet (Canton Network Forum)
- **Open-source DEX routing SDK proposed for Canton so apps can route swaps across DEXs from one integration** — The proposed SDK takes two tokens and returns the best route with an unsigned execution plan, with no keys, no signing, no hosted backend and no fees; bridges, wallets and apps could use it as the last-mile swap after bridging without integrating each DEX separately, DEXs join by writing a small adapter and opening a pull request — Cantex and TradeCraft are first on the list — and the Canton DEX Aggregation SDK proposal in the Canton Development Fund is still looking for a champion (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Saxon releases self-hosted KMS drivers so Canton validators can keep keys outside AWS and Google Cloud
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 3:42 AM ET)
- **Saxon releases self-hosted KMS drivers so Canton validators can keep keys outside AWS and Google Cloud** — The validator security guide tells operators to keep participant keys in a KMS or HSM, but the only supported options have been AWS KMS and Google Cloud KMS; Saxon has now released two Apache-2.0 drivers, for OpenBao / HashiCorp Vault Transit and for Scaleway Key Manager, both passing Digital Asset's KMS driver test suite and running a DevNet validator end to end, while a Dev Fund proposal under RFP 26 seeks a year of maintenance plus a PKCS#11 driver for hardware HSMs and still needs a Tech & Ops Champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **Obsidian Systems prepares a machine-checked semantics of Daml-LF 2 so Daml analysis tools can be tested against a public model** — No public, machine-checked semantics of Daml-LF 2 exists today, so a tool with a wrong model can report an unsafe package as safe; the RFP 22 proposal would build an executable semantics of Daml-LF 2.x and the Canton ledger model in Agda over 12 months, with proofs on Splice code covering authorization, Canton Coin issuance, the CIP-0098 reward cap and the CIP-0105 lock schedule, and is seeking a Tech & Ops Champion and a technical reviewer (Canton Network Forum)
- **Pinnaccle approved as a Featured App as the new Featured App rules take effect** — The Canton Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Pinnaccle for Featured App status, which still needs on-chain approval by the Super Validators; Featured App status boosts the Canton Coin rewards an application earns for the activity it drives on Canton, and the approval arrived alongside version 2.0b of the Featured App Guidance taking effect on November 5 (CC Space)

item.description:

- **Further Asset Management approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first with a dedicated Middle East presence** — Approved under CIP-0113, the Abu Dhabi-based firm moves from capital provider to network operator, running a Super Validator node linking the UAE ecosystem and holding governance rights over upgrades and protocol parameters, with a portfolio of custody, tokenisation, payment and trading companies already building on Canton (Further Asset Management)
- **Featured App Guidance v2.0b is now in force, tightening how Canton apps earn rewards** — Effective November 5, application markers must match the burn they correspond to one-for-one and the featured app reward cap falls from $1.50 to $0.79; the Accountability Committee measures each app's marker-to-burn ratio and an app above 103% may be paused without further warning (Canton Network Forum)
- **Cancore lets Canton assets trade atomically with public chains without wrapped tokens or custodial bridges** — Live on Canton mainnet since April 2026 as a Featured App, Cancore's non-custodial settlement layer trades Canton assets directly against assets on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum One and Robinhood Chain, with Tron recently onboarded, and either executes a trade in full or not at all, without the user's signing key leaving their device (Cancore)

item.title: Canton MainNet completes its migration to CantonBFT, the network's native consensus ordering system
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 12:12 AM ET)
- **Canton MainNet completes its migration to CantonBFT, the network's native consensus ordering system** — More than 800 nodes made the switch to CantonBFT with almost no downtime, replacing the single-leader CometBFT ordering setup with several validators ordering blocks in parallel; Digital Asset expects the change to open a path to more than 2,500 transactions per second, a figure that remains an expectation rather than a measured mainnet result (CoinMarketCap)
- **REX-Osprey Canton Coin ETF registration becomes effective today, November 13** — A post-effective amendment filed with the SEC on October 15 designated today as the effective date for the fund, a series of ETF Opportunities Trust that seeks 1x the performance of Canton Coin and would invest at least 80% of net assets in CC exposure; registration taking effect is not a trading launch, and the filing sets no exchange listing or trading date (Coinranking)
- **Canton industry working group completes a fourth cross-border repo round, adding tokenised Gilts as collateral for the first time** — The February 24 round run by Digital Asset and partner institutions also marked the first cross-currency intraday repo using tokenised Gilts against non-GBP tokenised deposits, with Archax joining as a new participant to create regulated digital representations of traditional Gilts and LSEG's DiSH network serving as the cash leg (Blockonomi)
- **Ledger data shows Canton burned about 15 million CC a day for traffic in the month to November 6, while minting ran ahead of burns** — From October 29 to November 6 the network minted about 21.9 million new CC a day against about 15.2 million burned, leaving roughly 6.7 million CC a day of net new supply; four nodes — Temple, Kora, Cantor8 and Obsidian — together accounted for 87.5% of all CC spent on traffic (CC Tools)

item.title: Supanova launches Canton's first permissionless token launchpad, opening the network to retail token creation
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 11:42 PM ET)
- **Supanova launches Canton's first permissionless token launchpad, opening the network to retail token creation** — Supanova went live on November 3 as a permissionless launchpad where users can create and trade tokens through a Canton-based wallet and app, with tokens graduating to its own automated market maker DEX; the platform reported about 10 million CC in trading volume in less than a day after launch, charges a 1% trading fee with most allocated to the token creator, and broadens a network previously associated primarily with institutional infrastructure (Ad-hoc News)

item.description:

- **Canton Foundation launches official Daml 3 developer certification** — The Canton Developer Certification pairs free self-paced courses with a $150 certification exam, giving developers worldwide a structured path to build applications for regulated financial markets; based on Daml 3 and Canton 3.x, it validates practical mastery of the authorization and privacy principles behind Canton's contracts and lets existing Daml 2 developers migrate to a single current stack, with Foundation COO Amanda Martin framing it as a common professional standard for the ecosystem (HTX)

- **CIP-0116 ties Featured App status to Canton Coin lock-ups** — Under the adopted proposal, featured applications approved for Canton Coin rewards must lock CC to keep their status — 5 million CC for most apps and 25 million CC for asset issuers, with a 60-day release period — and lose featured status if their lock falls below the required amount (Datawallet)
